name: Emaki
summary: Official Swift SDK for emaki (emaki.ai), the Seedance 2.5 AI video generator.
description: Official SDK for emaki (emaki.ai), the Japanese-language AI video generator for Seedance 2.5 and Seedance 2.0. Turn a prompt (or a first frame) into a video clip or an image on your emaki account and get back the URL of the finished file.
